entries.title: I Chronicles 12:1
segments: ¶Now these [were] the men who came to David at Ziklag while he was still a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish; and they [were] among the mighty men, helpers in the war,

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:2
segments: armed with bows, using both the right hand and the left in [hurling] stones and [shooting] arrows with the bow. [They were] of Benjamin, Saul's brethren.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:3
segments: The chief [was] Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet the sons of Azmaveth; Berachah, and Jehu the Anathothite;

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:4
segments: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, and Jozabad the Gederathite;

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:5
segments: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite;

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:6
segments: Elkanah, Jisshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:7
segments: and Joelah and Zebadiah the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:8
segments: [Some] Gadites joined David at the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for battle, who could handle shield and spear, whose faces [were like] the faces of lions, and [were] as swift as gazelles on the mountains:

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:9
segments: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:10
segments: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:11
segments: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:12
segments: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:13
segments: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbanai the eleventh.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:14
segments: These [were] from the sons of Gad, captains of the army; the least was over a hundred, and the greatest was over a thousand.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:15
segments: These [are] the ones who crossed the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all [those] in the valleys, to the east and to the west.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:16
segments: Then some of the sons of Benjamin and Judah came to David at the stronghold.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:17
segments: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said to them, "If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if to betray me to my enemies, since [there is] no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers look and bring judgment."

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:18
segments: Then the Spirit came upon Amasai, chief of the captains, [and he said: "We are] yours, O David; We [are] on your side, O son of Jesse! Peace, peace to you, And peace to your helpers! For your God helps you." So David received them, and made them captains of the troop.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:19
segments: And [some] from Manasseh defected to David when he was going with the Philistines to battle against Saul; but they did not help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away by agreement, saying, "He may defect to his master Saul [and endanger] our heads."

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:20
segments: When he went to Ziklag, those of Manasseh who defected to him were Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of the thousands who [were] from Manasseh.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:21
segments: And they helped David against the bands [of raiders], for they [were] all mighty men of valor, and they were captains in the army.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:22
segments: For at [that] time they came to David day by day to help him, until [it was] a great army, like the army of God.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:23
segments: ¶Now these [were] the numbers of the divisions [that were] equipped for war, [and] came to David at Hebron to turn [over] the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the LORD:

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:24
segments: of the sons of Judah bearing shield and spear, six thousand eight hundred armed for war;

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:25
segments: of the sons of Simeon, mighty men of valor fit for war, seven thousand one hundred;

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:26
segments: of the sons of Levi four thousand six hundred;

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:27
segments: Jehoiada, the leader of the Aaronites, and with him three thousand seven hundred;

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:28
segments: Zadok, a young man, a valiant warrior, and from his father's house twenty-two captains;

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:29
segments: of the sons of Benjamin, relatives of Saul, three thousand (until then the greatest part of them had remained loyal to the house of Saul);

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:30
segments: of the sons of Ephraim twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men throughout their father's house;

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:31
segments: of the half-tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, who were designated by name to come and make David king;

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:32
segments: of the sons of Issachar who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their chiefs were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their command;

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:33
segments: of Zebulun there were fifty thousand who went out to battle, expert in war with all weapons of war, stouthearted men who could keep ranks;

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:34
segments: of Naphtali one thousand captains, and with them thirty-seven thousand with shield and spear;

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:35
segments: of the Danites who could keep battle formation, twenty-eight thousand six hundred;

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:36
segments: of Asher, those who could go out to war, able to keep battle formation, forty thousand;

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:37
segments: of the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, from the other side of the Jordan, one hundred and twenty thousand armed for battle with every [kind] of weapon of war.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:38
segments: All these men of war, who could keep ranks, came to Hebron with a loyal heart, to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest of Israel [were] of one mind to make David king.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:39
segments: And they were there with David three days, eating and drinking, for their brethren had prepared for them.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:40
segments: Moreover those who were near to them, from as far away as Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, were bringing food on donkeys and camels, on mules and oxen-provisions of flour and cakes of figs and cakes of raisins, wine and oil and oxen and sheep abundantly, for [there was] joy in Israel.
